footnotes_verbatim: * (i) Unichem Farmaceutica Do Brasil Ltda, (ii) Unichem Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc., (iii) Niche Generics Limited, (iv) Unichem S.A. Pty Ltd and (v) Unichem (China) Pvt. Ltd. are wholly owned subsidiaries of Unichem Laboratories Ltd, India.
1) Financial reporting period of all subsidiaries is 31st March.

2) Exchange rate considered as on March 31, 2026 1 USD = ₹ 94.83, 1 STG £ = ₹125.59, 1 N (Nigerian Naira) = ₹ 0.0684 1 AUD $ = ₹ 65.07, 1 BRL (Brazilian Real) = ₹18.01, 1 EURO = ₹ 109.01, 1 ZAR (South African Rand) = ₹5.53, 1 RMB (Chinese Yuan) = ₹13.72.
3) Ipca Pharma (NZ) Pty. Ltd., New Zealand is a wholly owned subsidiary of Ipca pharma (Australia) Pty. Ltd.
4) Onyx Scientific Ltd., UK is wholly owned subsidiary of Ipca Laboratories (UK) Ltd., UK.
5) During the year, effective January 31, 2026 Ipca Pharmaceuticals, Inc. USA has sold one of its wholly owned subsidiary, Bayshore Pharmaceuticals LLC.
6) Ipca Pharmaceuticals, Inc. USA holds 90 % and Onyx Scientific Ltd., UK holds 10 % Share capital of Pisgah Laboratories Inc. USA.

7) Ipca Laboratories Limited acquired direct ownership of Unichem Laboratories Limited, Ireland from its subsidiary company Unichem Laboratories Limited, effective April 30, 2025. The financial metrics presented in this statement cover the standard reporting period of April 01, 2025 to March 31, 2026 as the entity was already under the operational control of the Company as a step-down subsidiary.
8) Ipca Laboratories Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, "Ipca Pharmaceuticals GmbH", effective from October 16, 2025.

Part B: *Cost fully written off in books. No effect of share of loss / profit from CCPL Software Pvt. Ltd. is taken since 1st April 2004, as the Company has no further commitment towards its share either of loss / profit in this company.
